notes.title: Join the new ITER-8 Steam playtest!
notes.content:
//Begin Transmission

Attention, operators!

There's two pieces of big news from Corporate that we'd like to relay: 

1) ITER is now ITER-8. They think it sounds cool. Moving on.

2) The ITER-8 playtest is now live on Steam! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2832310/ITER8/
Suit up and make your way to the Drill Ship!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157539/86bb16ff5d09dbcf53a648e7c8c17208e66dca9d.gif

This playtest will give you access to the perfectly safe winter biome and ITER-8's first boss. You'll be able to try your hand at mining, upgrading your weapons, and most importantly, defending company property from enemy attacks. 

If you enjoy the playtest, wonderful! Welcome to the team. If you don't enjoy the playtest, tough.* Your service is non-negotiable. 

Best of luck out there, operators! We'll see you (hopefully) on your (uncertain) return.

//End Transmission 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157539/00c8ee2e792dfd3bf1a14da4c067760a45277244.gif

*We are of course actively gathering feedback as we continue development, and your thoughts are super important to us! Please do let us know how you get on with the playtest. (HR states that legally we have to say "we greatly value your feedback" - but this time, we actually mean it.)

notes.title: Brand New ITER Demo Now Live on Itch.io!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We’re excited to share that a brand new, free demo for ITER is now available to download and play on Itch.io, and this version will remain live indefinitely!

Whether you're completely new to ITER or just itching to jump back in after the recent playtest, this version gives you a great slice of the surface loop, packed with content, polish, and replayability.

Each run can take anywhere from 20 to 60 minutes, with around 4 to 8 hours of gameplay available depending on your approach. This demo represents roughly 15–20% of the full game and is built to be replayed, experimented with, and pushed to its limits.

🔗 Check out the ITER Itch.io page here!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157539/4850db0e31c9657b88ca80c4a30ae12eef125483.gif

Demo Highlights

> Free to Play & No Time Limit 
Experience the Demo at your own pace.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157539/d9b8a4141046453be81b2ca61ee9010659af34d6.gif

> Progress up to the First Boss Fight
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157539/4e89366c98312375aed4ef0097eaa8a384203f73.gif

> Designed for Multiple Playthroughs
- Meta progression that unlocks new upgrades between runs.
- Randomized abilities, weather events and temporary upgrades to keep each run fresh!
- Tower upgrades that evolve how you defend your base.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157539/6a18a19e255339104ab24c9340ca697975c77dad.gif

> Enhanced Visuals and Improved Gameplay
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157539/d12493b4b3aa8ca78e5d78e40ad9000077c741b2.gif

Let Us Know What You Think!
We’re always looking to hear from the community, so if you give the demo a try, please consider dropping your thoughts on the Steam Discussions, in our Discord or over in our Itch Community.
We’d love to know how your runs went, what you enjoyed, and what you’d like to see more of.

Thanks so much for your support, and we hope you enjoy your time on the surface!

Full Demo Content
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157539/dfc9c7251b4a3ef3fd10908c3811a6504b5a165b.png

How to Download and Install the Demo
- Head over to https://fluckymachine.itch.io/iter

- Scroll down and click the Download Button to start the download

- Extract the .Zip File
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157539/256d337b4c9fa7141df299ab37989968358df3b5.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157539/c85ea13d0c26fbe4cee0ea2d4aee0ba083d00b44.png

notes.title: ITER Playtest Has Ended, Thanks for Playing!
notes.content:
Hey folks!

Just a quick update, our public playtest for ITER has officially ended.

A huge thank-you to everyone who jumped in, explored, mined, exploded, and gave us feedback. It’s been incredibly helpful, and we’re already working on the next phase.

This won’t be the last time you’ll see ITER in playable form, more news and more updates are coming soon.

Until next time!
- The ITER Team

notes.title: Attention Operators! The ITER Open Playtest is NOW LIVE.
notes.content:
// Begin Transmission
Greetings, both current and prospective Operators!

The ITER Corporation is pleased to announce that the Open Playtest for ITER will begin RIGHT NOW!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157539/17f3f70201c7904178a5831af55de9f5ca1145a5.png

This is your privileged opportunity to get your hands dirty on the surface, experiencing the rigorous training regime (via our brand-new tutorial!) and proving your expendable worth by progressing up to your first major confrontation with the local unscheduled resistance.

How to Participate
Head to the ITER Steam Store Page to download the Open Playtest Demo and begin your contribution to the Undercity's survival effort. Remember, resources are scarce, and Operators are numerous. Don't let your potential go to waste!

Share Your Feedback
Besides the standard Resource Extraction and Defence protocols, your secondary objective is to provide VALUABLE FEEDBACK.

ITER Corp values efficiency. We will look to enhance our operational procedures based on your unique surface experiences (assuming your experience report isn't lost in the data void upon your inevitable demise).

Please utilise one of the following approved channels for submitting your feedback and operational insights:

- ITER Playtest Feedback Form
- Steam Discussion Forums

Thank you for your compliance. We look forward to hearing your feedback and are excited for you to experience ITER!

//End Transmission

notes.title: Dev update: A look back (and forward!)
notes.content:
//Begin Transmission

Hey everyone! 👋

We just wanted to give you a little update and a look behind-the-scenes at where we're at with ITER!

Firstly, a BIG thanks to everyone who took part in our playtest last November. Your comments have been super helpful, and we'll be continuing to build our game while taking your feedback on board. Thanks, Operators! 🚀

The Great Undercity has had an upgrade... 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157539/2717e88f84f4ec4d8c780139c76875e67095c04b.gif

So far this year we've been hard at work on our survival space game, and we've been having loads of fun improving features and tweaking the art. We've been experimenting with the landscape of the Undercity, giving the environment more of an out-of-this-universe feel! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157539/2b4588745135abbb7c8a0610012772ae46a2de8c.png

A trip down memory lane! 

We also thought it'd be cool to share some of the concept art and designs that we contemplated. Here's how our hard-working Operator buddy came to be: 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157539/111ac7b24a30feaaae7dfac1ab15526d27543cc6.png

We loved all these versions, but feel the final Operator looks humble, brave, and willing to get the job done! We also have some early concepts of the enemies that'll attack your base: 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157539/39820386f6ce9b8451629330902a100724258e6e.png

We'll share the final designs of these baddies in the near future! 🛸

In the meantime, we'll get back to building our game and making it as awesome as possible. Talk soon!

- fluckyMachine 

//End Transmission

notes.title: 🚨Playtest Extended Through the Weekend! 🚨
notes.content:
Good news, Operators!

We’re extending the ITER playtest through the weekend to give even more of you a chance to suit up and dive into the action. Whether you've been mining tirelessly or haven’t had the chance to join yet, now’s the time to experience the game and provide your crucial feedback.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157539/42196dd9619fc8078d2ee1cc92c4168289710099.gif

Why Join the Playtest?

 Get an early look at ITER and help us shape the game’s future.
 Face the challenges of the surface. Mine, defend, and upgrade your way to success.
 Have fun and contribute to making the Undercity’s restoration project the best it can be.

How to Participate

 Visit our Steam page and click "Request Access" to join the playtest.
 Download the playtest build and jump in to start exploring, mining, and battling your way through the surface.

Your Feedback Matters (and a chance to win a £25 Voucher!) 
After playing, make sure to fill out the Playtest Feedback Form - your input is vital for improving the game.

Everyone who submits the feedback form will be entered into a random draw to win a £25 Steam voucher! There’s still time to play, submit your thoughts, and take a shot at winning.

Thank you to everyone who has already joined the playtest and shared their thoughts! This extension is your chance to refine your skills and help us perfect the game before it moves into its next phase.

The Undercity is counting on you, Operators—good luck on the surface!

- The ITER Team

notes.title: The ITER Playtest is Live!
notes.content:
Attention Operators,

The time has come to suit up and take your first steps on the surface! The ITER  playtest is now live, and we’re looking for brave Operators to join us in testing the game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157539/73bec57b9ebf3be273157029ae39899b22fc8cf5.png

How to Join the Playtest
Joining the playtest is simple:

1. Head to our Steam Store Page.
2. Click the "Request Access" button on the playtest section.
3. The first 100 applicants will be automatically accepted, so act fast!

Once you’re in, download the playtest build and start mining, defending, and upgrading your way through the harsh surface environment. Your feedback will help shape the future of ITER!

Help Us Improve the Game
We’d love to hear your thoughts after you’ve had a chance to play.
Be sure to fill out our 
Playtest Feedback Form

💡 Why fill out the form? 💡

Your feedback directly impacts the game’s development.
One lucky Operator who fills out the form will win a £25 Steam Voucher!
The winner will be chosen at random after the playtest ends, so don’t miss your chance to contribute and possibly win.

Need Help?
If you encounter any issues or bugs during the playtest, please report them on our Steam Community Hub, use the Playtest Feedback Form or join our Discord server to let us know.

Thank you for helping us refine Journey to the Surface! Your bravery and insights are invaluable to the mission.

Good luck, Operators - we’re counting on you.

- ITER Corp

notes.title: ITER Playtest Rescheduled to November 21st
notes.content:
Houston, we've had a problem...

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157539/9c704946fa77b70e5525f36b454cf6d274d4a865.jpg

//Begin Transmission

Attention, Operators! 

We have important news about your upcoming mission to the surface. 

During final preparations, our team encountered an unforeseen bug affecting gameplay stability. To ensure the smoothest possible experience, we’ve made the decision to delay the playtest by one week.

The revised launch date to the surface is now set for Thursday, November 21st. This extra time will allow us to implement the necessary fixes, making sure you’ll be able to explore, exploit and excavate as much of the local material as possible.

Thank you for your patience, Operator. This playtest is a critical step for ITER, and your efforts (and inevitable sacrifices) on the frontline are pivotal for the survival of future workers!

Stay tuned for further updates, and don’t forget to join our  Discord  if you haven’t already! Check out the get roles channel to secure your Playtester role and receive communication when we’re ready to deploy.

We look forward to your service!

- ITER Corp

//End Transmission

notes.title: Join the Upcoming Playtest on Discord!
notes.content:
Greetings, Operators!

We’re excited to announce that the first public playtest for ITER  will be launching this Thursday within our official Discord! This is your chance to join ITER Corp’s ranks, venture to the surface, and get hands-on with the mission at hand. Whether you’re mining resources, defending the Undercity, or upgrading your gear, this mission is critical—and your role, while temporary, is essential.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157539/1c3cee6ae766bfd78fecc04307a98e4766a44d42.jpg

How to Join the Playtest:

 Step 1: Join our official Discord server
 Step 2: Head to the get roles channel and react to the post to obtain the Playtester role.
 Step 3: Watch for updates on Thursday when the mission goes live. Our team will provide all details on how to participate.

Your bravery in facing the unknown is appreciated. And remember, each playtest Operator's feedback will be invaluable in helping us refine and perfect Journey to the Surface for future recruits.

Don’t miss out on this chance to shape the frontline experience for all who follow. See you on the surface, Operator!

- ITER Corp
